question: Can the corrected deterministic selector produce exactly 50 structural-event-preserving, tunnel-balanced anchors with at least 5 m global Euclidean spacing on every fixed topology?
reason_now: The sealed v2b LiDAR pilot stopped on P04 because event-first farthest-point fill produced only 38/50 anchors even though the topology has sufficient centerline length and candidate density.

method.event_stage: Preserve terminal, junction-center/offset and strongest horizontal-turn event neighborhoods first.
method.candidate_stage: Interpolate candidate locations every 0.5 m of spline arc length, independent of upstream spline-knot density.
method.target_stage: Visit tunnel IDs in deterministic round-robin order and accept the earliest candidate satisfying the global 5 m Euclidean spacing until exactly 50 anchors are selected.
method.audit: Require exact count, pairwise spacing, every structural event within 5 m of an anchor, every tunnel represented, selected-per-tunnel spread no greater than 3 and byte-identical deterministic replay.

evidence.machine_readable: Five anchor JSON files, five per-parent audit JSON files, input hashes, P05 graph/spline, aggregate summary and deterministic replay hashes.
evidence.visual: Five complete X-Y/X-Z spline-and-anchor maps plus one aggregate spacing/balance figure; all 250 anchors shown with no best-case selection.
evidence.claim_boundary: A PASS validates only the sampling algorithm and permits review before a separately approved LiDAR rerun. It is not a sensor, dataset, learning, topology-runtime or navigation PASS.

execution_policy: One immutable execution only. Reuse no failed output directory; do not generate mesh or rays; do not lower count/spacing, change seeds/templates, retry or select a replacement topology.
stop_rule: Stop and seal if any source hash, topology family, exact count, spacing, event coverage, tunnel coverage, balance, replay, evidence, time or disk check fails.
data_card_policy: No data card is required because operation=infrastructure and this run creates zero sensor observations, labels, formal dataset samples or training inputs; exact source and sampling scope are frozen in this approved proposal and run spec.

estimated_cost.compute: One frozen-E1 CPU process, four read-only graph/spline inputs and one graph-only P05 construction; no mesh, Open3D raycasting, GPU, simulator or training.

approval.confirmation_reference: 用户在获知完整主线以及当前先修复结构采样、再做零射线五图审计的范围后回复：做吧
